Attached is the initial day-1 slate for Veridian's onsite workshop on May 18. This is intentionally tight; Veridian asked for a compact agenda that balances strategy, security, and a technical deep-dive. Please review presenter ownership below and confirm by EOD Tuesday so I can lock travel and AV.

- Confirm presenter owners for each slot (see assignments inline).
- Slide & pre-read drop: consolidated single PDF preferred; deadline = COB Tuesday May 11 (slides + 1-page pre-read per session).
- Speaker travel window: May 17 arrivals, May 19 departures. If anyone needs a different window, flag now (we have limited budget for extra nights).

- 09:00–09:20 Opening + objectives — Olga Petrov (Redwood)
- 09:20–10:05 Customer outcomes & KPIs — Marissa Cole (Redwood) — 30 min talk + 15m Q&A
- 10:15–11:00 Security & compliance deep-dive — Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — includes SOC2 + data-flow diagram
- 11:15–12:30 Technical deep-dive & demo — Connor O'Brien (Redwood) — live demo (30m) + integration patterns
- 13:30–15:00 Breakouts & use-case clinics — split rooms (owners TBD)

I've attached a Presenter_Handoff_Template.xlsx to speed slide collection. Marissa / Lauren / Connor — please add your slide lead, any AV needs, and confirm if you require a 60m or 45m slot (Connor I left you at 75m including demo but can compress).

Sofia / Jared — if the slate looks reasonable, please confirm attendee headcount and any procurement constraints for speaker travel (per prior notes, Veridian will approve up to 2 speaker nights).

I'll consolidate and circulate the final slate + single drive folder once ownership is confirmed.

Thanks,
